# Paper Lab: Complete Overview

> A modern academic paper editor designed specifically for IEEE and journal formats.

## Introduction
Paper Lab (available at https://paperlab.r3actr.com) is a comprehensive online platform designed to streamline the academic paper authoring process. It eliminates the steep learning curve of raw LaTeX environments by providing a powerful, accessible, and fast IEEE & Journal WYSIWYG editor.

## Core Capabilities

### 1. IEEE & Journal WYSIWYG Editing
At its core, Paper Lab offers a rich-text visual WYSIWYG editor tailored specifically for IEEE and top academic journals (Elsevier, Springer Nature, ACM, MDPI). Users can structure sections, insert mathematical formulas, manage references, and generate camera-ready PDF and Word (.docx) documents without wrestling with LaTeX syntax or local dependencies.

### 2. High-Performance Cloud Compiling
To ensure a smooth user experience, Paper Lab uses priority cloud compilation. This means that document previews and final camera-ready PDF generations are processed quickly on dedicated servers, significantly reducing wait times for large manuscripts.

### 3. Integrated WYSIWYG Diagram Editor
One of the most unique features is the built-in "What You See Is What You Get" (WYSIWYG) diagram editor. Instead of writing complex TikZ or importing external images, users can draw diagrams directly within the platform and insert them instantly into their research papers as sharp vector figures.

## Target Audience
Paper Lab is primarily built for:
- University students and graduate researchers writing IEEE conference and journal papers.
- Academic researchers publishing manuscripts in scientific journals.
- Anyone who wants camera-ready academic typesetting combined with a modern visual WYSIWYG interface.

## Support & Resources
